card.name: Capacity and frequency nouns in limits
card.fires_on: Nouns or adverbs about amount, room or frequency, such as space, capacity, frequency, often, hours. They sit right after a word like classroom, dosing, pipeline or more.

modes.label: Dose frequency wording
modes.description: Words about how often or how much of a drug is used, in dosing warnings.
modes.example: should not be used more<< often>> than recommended, at higher doses than recommended

modes.label: Capacity and demand in general text
modes.description: Nouns for room or capacity in news or opinion text about limited resources.
modes.example: how much pipeline<< capacity>> would be needed

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and give no clear effect on the output.
card.plain: It marks words about how much room, capacity or how often something is used, in drug dosing text and in general text about limited resources.
